figures.derivation: Read from OBR's published chart data rather than from any sentence, because OBR prints no such number. The "Average-wage migrant worker" series of Chart 4.13 is 297.29678429890674 at age 82, on an axis the chart image labels "Cumulative fiscal impact (£ thousand)", which is £297,297 and is what this site publishes, rounded to the nearest thousand, as £297,000. THE AGE IS THIS SITE'S CHOICE AND OBR NAMES NONE. Age 82 was chosen by the owner on 3 August 2026 because it is the life expectancy OBR's own text gives an average person in 2028, and so is the only one of the candidates OBR states a reason for; the record published age 80, £340,577, until that day. The age decides the sign as well as the size: the same series peaks at £533,832 at age 66 and is -£308,275 at age 100, where the chart ends. The representative UK resident OBR compares on the same basis is -£47,056 at age 82.
